reviews.title: Trouble syncing, can’t correct errors
reviews.text: I continually have to disconnect and reconnect with my Apple health app in order to sync. Also, if you accidentally bump start tracking when you’re not ready to, for instance, if you’re checking your daily sleep history, etc., you cannot go back and delete that days record and start over. Hence you lose the ability to track that day’s sleep. My employer add money to my HSA based on wellness tracking including sleep. If they don’t sync and I can’t go back and update an incorrect entry then that does not count towards my HSA goals. Very frustrating.

reviews.title: App Hacked With Ad!
reviews.text: I enjoyed the app but once I paid the $29.99 subscription for a year I started getting pop-up ads when I wanted to see my statistics and to go back to home. I canceled the app after 10 days and all of my data was lost and now if I want to buy it again, I have to pay Another fee. I would like a refund on my $29.99 subscription. Also my Apple account was hacked with other fees with an unidentified phone number attached to it, and I had to cancel my credit card and assign a new credit card to my Apple account. I’m very nervous and cautious  about using this app again.
